# Source: The Festival

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** The Festival
- **Artist / culture:** Edward John Poynter (English, 1836–1919)
- **Date:** 1875
- **Style:** nineteenth century
- **Classification:** oil on canvas
- **Department:** Painting and Sculpture of Europe
- **AIC artwork ID:** 160032
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/160032
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/d5133cb6-4ea6-d2f6-3391-e1b47f3f1022/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Festival

## Extracted source palette

`#181818, #581818, #483828, #887868, #685848, #A89878, #C8B898, #886848`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#0C0C0C`
- `surface`: `#282828`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#581818`
- `on_primary`: `#F8F8F6`
- `secondary`: `#C8B898`
- `surface_variant`: `#282828`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#4E4E4E`
- `error`: `#581818`
- `on_error`: `#F8F8F6`

- Font: `comic-neue` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `20dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `18.4:1`, surface `13.86:1`
- Variant contrast: `13.86:1`
- Control contrast: `12.67:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
